These are indeed exciting times for Quoin as we continue to move closer towards achieving our goal of delivering the first approved treatment for Netherton Syndrome.” QRX003 – Netherton Syndrome Positive Interim Data from Phase 2/3 Study CL-QRX003-004 .
On August 28, 2026, Quoin reported positive interim results from CL-QRX003-004, its ongoing Phase 2/3 study of QRX003 4% lotion in patients with Netherton Syndrome.

In the interim analysis of the first six participants to complete 12 weeks of treatment, four of six (66.7%) achieved the primary endpoint of a 1-grade or greater improvement in Investigator Global Assessment (p=0.0087 vs. a pre-specified alpha of 0.0215).
Quoin expects to complete recruitment of all 20 participants by the end of 2026 and to report topline data in the second quarter of 2027.
